closed_gaps.closure_evidence: A later 3090 session drained _diag/dicos-f-03/queue completely; the queue directory now holds only done/. All 24 metrics_epoch_*.json files for epochs 0091-0114 were imported through scripts/refresh_continuation_outputs.py on 2026-08-15 and each passed validate_metric: schema_version 1, kind cbsc-zdc-large-validation-diagnostic, split validation, n_events 4000, split_counts train 0 / validation 4000 / test 0, and the full diagnostic QA gate with test_events_used 0.
closed_gaps.consequence_at_closure: The diagnostic trend is now continuous over epochs 48-114 with no declared gap. The accepted best is unchanged: dicos-f-02 epoch 90 at 4.483767619419238 remains the family best because dicos-f-03's own best, 4.491971 at epoch 111, does not improve on it.
